Confirmed by call sites in NativeRenderNode.kt:394 (AudioResampler(22050, HslColorConfig.anInt339)) and VorbisOggDecoder.kt:67 (AudioResampler(aVorbisInfo9006.rate, HslColorConfig.anInt339)) - HslColorConfig.anInt339 is the audio device's actual output sample rate (used to build javax.sound AudioFormat in JavaSoundOutput.kt:47), a clearly misnamed static field from decompiler class-merging. If source != target, computes gcd via TerrainTileShape.method2726(-21806, i, i_27_) (a GCD helper, confirmed by its swap-then-Euclid-style body), reduces both rates by the gcd into anInt2164 (source/gcd, becomes the polyphase table's phase count) and anInt2159 (target/gcd, the phase-increment). Builds anIntArrayArray2163, an array of anInt2164 filter-phase tables of 14 fixed-point (Q16, *65536) windowed-sinc coefficients (Hamming-like window via cos(...)*0.46+0.54) each covering a +-7 tap window around the phase's fractional offset - textbook polyphase resampling filter bank construction.

Applies the polyphase FIR filter bank to a 16-bit PCM sample buffer to change its sample rate. Only called from VorbisOggDecoder.kt:79 with literal -56 for the first arg: aAudioResampler_8994!!.method1268(-56, ...). Inside, i_0_ = 14 % ((i - 48) / 33) is computed but never used again anywhere in the method - classic dead/opaque-predicate local, the first Int param has zero effect on behavior. Real logic (only runs if anIntArrayArray2163 != null, i.e. rates actually differ): estimates output length from anInt2159/anInt2164 ratio, does a 14-tap convolution per input sample using anIntArrayArray2163[phase] with `shr 2` scaling, accumulates into an Int buffer, advances output position by variable stride (i_9_ = phase-accumulator / anInt2164) each iteration (correct polyphase resampling stride), then rounds/clamps the accumulator (`(8192 + val) shr 14`, saturate to Short.MIN/MAX) into the returned ShortArray. If anIntArrayArray2163 is null (no resampling needed) the input array is returned unchanged.
